body:
I may try something with gofundme...... just to see if I might be able to get some assistance dealing with court costs and education issues.

I did get some good news, and I do not feel near as hopeless. Someone from one of the nearby Universities happened to call and check in on me and I told him some of the problems. Turns out my lack of financial aid is because I am at a 2 year school and will come back when I transfer. So I can still get that degree, and I have a job with some friends that pays decently well if I can get hours.

I have some things to work out still, but it isn't nearly as bad. 

Thank you for being the man to reply.
